verdict.rationale: Kimi's own help-center index lists 定时任务 (scheduled tasks) among its general assistant features, so the product appears to ship a first-party scheduling capability. The evidence is only a single category heading with no detail on how it works. missing for 10: documentation distinguishing recurring schedules from one-off runs, how tasks execute automatically, how results are delivered back to the user, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule recurring or one-off tasks that run automatically and come back to me with results

citations.quote: 搜索、记忆、定时任务、技能等通用功能
